title: Strategy & Research Analyst
description:
**Role Overview**




 This role sits in the Founder's Office, working directly with leadership on high\-visibility research. You'll study the US market — buyers, competitors, partners and compliance expectations — alongside product and user research, and turn findings into insights that Sales, Marketing and Product can act on, using Claude and other AI tools as your primary toolkit.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities**




  





**Research Deeply** 



* Research US buyer behavior, procurement cycles and market dynamics that shape how we sell into the US
* Apply product thinking to surface gaps and opportunities across our tools and offerings
* Benchmark US\-based competitors — track their pricing, positioning and moves
* Run user interviews to understand needs, friction and opportunities firsthand



  





**Connect \& Communicate** 



* Research potential US partners, resellers and marketplaces to support distribution
* Track US compliance and trust requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, data residency) that matter to buyers
* Bridge teams — feed research and insights to Sales, Marketing and Product
* Turn findings into clear documents, plans and presentations stakeholders can act on



  





**Tools \& Systems** 



* Coordinate with Engineering to confirm data availability, quality and structure
* Use Claude and other integratable AI tools for reporting, dashboards and data processing
* Design systems and processes that make research repeatable and easy to hand off
* Build with Claude and Claude Cowork to automate busywork and make your own process easier



  





**Required Skills**



* 0–2 years in a research, strategy or analyst\-adjacent role
* Proficient with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) for analysis and visualization — the primary toolkit, not a bonus
* Comfortable setting up AI\-powered automations and workflows (e.g. Claude, Zapier, n8n) to remove repetitive work
* Judgment to validate AI\-generated outputs against the actual data
* Reads technical docs and business requirements equally well
* Sharp written communication — this role lives in translation
* Curiosity to keep learning new tools, techniques and markets as they shift



  





**Good to Have**



* Familiarity with prompt\-based data workflows
* Prior experience as a functional bridge between tech and business teams
* Familiarity with BA frameworks (user stories, BRDs)
* Exposure to US SaaS/enterprise GTM motions or compliance frameworks (SOC 2, HIPAA)

title: Technology Analyst
description:
About the Role Technology Analyst (IMP NOTE \- This is not a Business Analyst or Data Analyst Role)  Introduction
 
 Oxford University Press is seeking an Analyst, DPM to support the development, enhancement, and delivery of innovative digital products that help advance learning and educational outcomes. This is an excellent opportunity for a technology\-focused professional who is passionate about digital product development and enjoys working in a collaborative, cross\-functional environment.
 



 As part of the Digital Product Management team, you will play an important role in supporting the development, customization, release, and maintenance of digital products. You will work closely with colleagues across Editorial, Marketing, Customer Services, and external technology partners, helping to deliver high\-quality digital solutions that support OUP's mission of advancing knowledge and learning.
 



 The role offers exposure to product management, agile delivery, digital content management, quality assurance, customer\-focused product enhancements, and educational technology. It is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, building innovative solutions, and contributing to the ongoing growth of digital learning products.
 


   Opportunity
 
 As Analyst, DPM, you will support the delivery of digital products throughout their lifecycle, ensuring high\-quality user experiences and timely product releases.
 



 Key responsibilities include:
 


* Supporting the development of new products, product features, and innovative ideas, including building quick MVPs to help stakeholders visualize product concepts.
* Developing feature backlogs and user stories, agreeing priorities with stakeholders, and supporting agile delivery of product enhancements within agreed timelines.
* Managing the sourcing, ingestion, and delivery of learning content for digital products.
* Enhancing digital content by enabling engaging digital interactions and learning experiences.
* Liaising with internal and external stakeholders to ensure quality, accuracy, and timely delivery of product releases.
* Supporting product development processes and ensuring adherence to quality standards.
* Coordinating Quality Assurance (QA) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities to ensure products meet performance and security requirements.
* Supporting the timely delivery of school updates, patches, installers, and software releases, including planning, testing, release note validation, and communication activities.
* Delivering product training sessions for Customer Services, Marketing, and other internal teams as required.
* Ensuring User Manuals, FAQs, Help Videos, and related support materials are maintained, updated, and of a high standard.
* Ensuring compliance requirements, NDA obligations, and third\-party processes are followed in accordance with group guidelines.
* Coordinating effectively with Editorial, Marketing, Customer Support, Finance teams, and third\-party vendor partners.


   Impact
 
 This role is critical in ensuring OUP's digital products are delivered efficiently, maintained to high standards, and continually improved to meet customer needs. By supporting product development, content delivery, quality assurance, and stakeholder collaboration, you will help drive successful product launches, improved customer experiences, and operational excellence across OUP's digital portfolio.
 


   About You Essential Criteria
 * B.Tech or MCA in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3\-4 years of IT experience.
* At least 1 year of experience in product development, product management, or project delivery roles.
* Experience in digital product creation, development, implementation, and execution.
* Experience working within the EdTech, K\-12, or Publishing domain.
* Experience supporting cloud\-enabled and web\-enabled solutions, including web and app\-based products.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Proven ability to coordinate with third\-party suppliers and delivery partners.
* Self\-motivated, creative, dedicated, and able to work independently.
* High level of integrity and ownership.


 Desirable Criteria
 * Experience working within agile product development environments.
* Exposure to QA, UAT, release management, and product lifecycle management.
* Experience managing customer\-facing digital products and implementations.
* Understanding of digital content workflows and learning technologies.
* Experience developing product documentation, training materials, and support resources.
* Knowledge of educational publishing and digital learning solutions.


   Queries
 
  
 



 Please contact 
 **shariq.anwar@oup.com** 
 with any queries relating to this role. To ensure a smooth application process, please submit your CV through this link than via email.

title: Growth Strategy Analyst - Market Research & Intelligence
description:
**Job Summary:** 




  





 We are looking for a GTM Analyst \- Market Research \& Insights (5 \- 10 years) to support our GTM, presales and bid teams with structured market, customer and competitive insights for RFPs, proactive proposals and go\-to\-market initiatives. The role sits within the presales team and works closely with Business Unit Heads, competency owners, solution architects, sales and senior management to sharpen GTM strategies and deal positioning.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




  





 \- Conduct secondary research on target accounts, industries and geographies to provide context, trends and benchmarks for RFPs, proposals and GTM plans.
 



  





 \- Build and maintain competitor profiles: offerings, positioning, pricing signals, win themes, differentiators and recent deals relevant to our GTM focus areas.
 



  





 \- Analyse RFPs/RFIs to extract business drivers, buying criteria and implicit needs, and map them to our GTM strategy and value propositions.
 



  





 \- Create insight packs for pursuits: market snapshots, customer landscape, stakeholder maps, SWOT, buyer personas, typical decision process and GTM implications.
 



  





 \- Support presales and sales with quantitative analysis: market sizing, opportunity assessment, TAM/SAM/SOM, basic financial and pricing analysis.
 



  





 \- Work with solution architects and sales to refine win themes, value propositions and proof points based on market and competitive intelligence.
 



  





 \- Draft data\-backed content for proposals, GTM presentations and sales collateral: industry trends, business case inputs, ROI models, benchmark data (using public sources or internal case studies).
 



  





 \- Maintain reusable GTM knowledge assets: sector playbooks, battle cards, case study libraries, standard statistics and reference data.
 



  





 \- Track and report on deal outcomes to derive patterns on why we win/lose; feed insights back into future bids and GTM strategies.
 



  





 \- Collaborate with marketing to align thought leadership, campaigns and sales collateral with deal\-level and GTM insights.
 



  





 \- Ensure all research follows compliance, confidentiality and citation standards.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




  





 \- 3 \- 6 years of experience in market research, consulting, business analysis, or strategy roles, preferably in IT/technology services or SaaS.
 



  





 \- Demonstrated experience in desk research, competitive analysis, and synthesising insights into executive\-ready outputs (slides, briefs, notes).
 



  





 \- Exposure to proposal processes; understanding of enterprise sales cycles and GTM motions is a strong plus.
 



  





 \- Experience working with cross\-functional teams (sales, presales, delivery, marketing, finance).
 



  





**Skills and competencies:** 




  





 \- Strong research and analytical skills; ability to work with both qualitative and quantitative data.
 



  





 \- Excellent business writing and storytelling skills; able to convert analysis into clear narratives and visuals.
 



  





 \- Good understanding of technology and digital/IT services landscape (cloud, data, apps, integrations, etc.) or willingness to ramp up quickly.
 



  





 \- Proficiency with Excel/Sheets (models, basic analytics) and PowerPoint/Slides (storyboarding, visualisation).
 



  





 \- Familiarity with research and intelligence tools (e.g., LinkedIn, company databases, industry reports); experience with any paid intel tools is a plus.
 



  





 \- High attention to detail, strong organisation and ability to support multiple bids and GTM initiatives in parallel under tight timelines.
 



  





 \- Stakeholder management skills; comfortable working closely with senior sales leaders and SMEs.
 



  





**Education:** 




  





 \- Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, IT, or related field.
 



  





 \- MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is a plus but not mandatory.
 



  





**Why This Role Is Attractive:** 




  





 \- Direct impact on deal wins and business growth by shaping the insights, GTM narratives and positioning that influence our most strategic pursuits.
 



  





 \- Opportunity to build a foundational presales and GTM intelligence capability for TTN, including reusable assets, win\-loss insights, and data\-driven decision frameworks for leadership.
 



  





 \- Steep learning curve across diverse industries, technologies and GTM strategies, giving you broad exposure and accelerated professional growth.
 



  





 \- Strong visibility with sales leadership, Business Unit Heads, solution architects and marketing, opening up future paths into sales leadership, business consulting, account management or practice roles.
 



  





 \- Chance to work at the intersection of business, technology and strategy, owning the research and insight layer that powers end\-to\-end solution narratives and GTM motions from discovery to closure.

title: Manager, Product Design
description:
**Who We Are** 




 Ontic provides software that helps corporate and government security teams identify threats, assess risk, and respond faster to keep people and organizations safe. Its AI\-powered Connected Intelligence Platform unifies security operations and data into a centralized system of record, enabling organizations to conduct risk assessments, protect against workplace violence, and manage threats and incidents more efficiently. Fortune 500 companies and federal agencies rely on Ontic to support security programs such as executive protection, threat intelligence, and corporate investigations. Learn more at ontic.ai or follow us on LinkedIn.
 



  





 As Design Manager, you'll lead a team of 5–6 product designers, owning both the day\-to\-day coordination of design work and the people management of your team. You'll be the connective tissue between planning, execution, and individual support; and you’ll be the person your designers rely on for feedback, growth, and career development.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Work allocation: Assign design work based on priorities, skills, and availability.
* Day\-to\-day operations: Keep projects moving and be the person designers go to when they're blocked.
* Engineering partnership: Be the main design counterpart for Engineering and Product leads on planning and delivery.
* Team health: Track how each designer is doing: who's thriving, who needs support and build plans to help each grow.
* Escalation point: Resolve blockers and cross\-team friction.
* Design operations support: Keep shared tools and processes current and followed. Help shape the evolving role of Design at Ontic, including the working agreements between Engineering, Product, and Design.
* Process Improvement: Identify and improve processes that slow progress or contribute to team frustration.
* Evolve our use of AI: Set high standards for how our team uses AI for design work; keep pushing that standard forward as the tools change.
* Hands\-on design work: While it’s not a core expectation of this role, you may pick up design work occasionally as team capacity requires.



  





**People Management** 



* Career growth: Build and maintain individual growth plans for each designer, tied to clear expectations for their level.
* Performance reviews: Own the performance review cycle, including calibration, ratings, and written feedback.Ensure you are providing feedback regularly, not just during review cycles.
* 1:1s and coaching: Meet regularly with each designer to coach through blockers, skill gaps, and career questions.
* Hiring: Lead sourcing, interviewing, and hiring decisions for open roles on the team when needed.
* Team structure and capacity: Plan team capacity against roadmap needs and flag gaps to leadership.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* 5\+ years of product design experience, including 2\+ years leading design teams.
* Design experience in enterprise SaaS; you understand the complexity, stakeholders, and constraints of B2B software.
* Strong technical craft across interaction design and user experience.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience managing people directly, including running 1:1s, writing performance reviews, building growth plans and having tough conversations when needed.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience improving design team processes or workflows, especially using AI tools.
* Experience implementing and scaling an established design system.
* Experience working in heavily regulated, data\-heavy problem spaces.
* A strong portfolio of UX Design work.

* Administer services, escalation policies, schedules, on\-call rotations, integrations, event routing, notification rules and user access.
* Troubleshoot alert delivery and integration failures; tune routing and escalation to reduce missed or noisy alerts and support reliable incident response.
* Maintain PagerDuty configuration, ownership maps, support procedures and audit\-ready documentation.



**End User Support and Customer Service \| Expert** 



* Provide Tier 2/3 support for Windows endpoints and enterprise applications, including internal employees and external consultants accessing client environments such as Epic and customer\-specific applications.
* Troubleshoot complex hardware, software, networking, authentication, profile, application and endpoint issues independently.
* Explain technical issues and solutions clearly to technical and non\-technical users while maintaining strong ownership and customer service.



**Printer Administration and Vendor Management \| Intermediate** 



* Serve as primary technical contact for managed print services and coordinate replacements, repairs and escalations with COBB or the designated print vendor.
* Troubleshoot printer deployment, connectivity, drivers, queues, mappings and end\-user printing; maintain inventory and lifecycle documentation.



**File Services and Collaboration Administration \| Intermediate** 



* Create, modify and troubleshoot SMB file shares, NTFS permissions and Active Directory security groups; resolve user access and permission issues.
* Assist with migration of legacy shares to SharePoint Online, OneDrive or Azure Files; document share structures and recommend modernization improvements.
* Work with authorized US\-based teams and Geo team data in accordance with access, privacy and security requirements.



**Azure Administration and Cloud Operations \| Working / Good Hands\-on** 



* Perform day\-to\-day Azure administration activities through the Azure Portal, including resource groups, subscriptions, virtual machines, storage accounts and basic network configuration.
* Support Microsoft Entra ID and hybrid identity operations, including user and group administration, role assignments, MFA, Conditional Access awareness, access reviews and troubleshooting of directory synchronization.
* Assist with Azure RBAC, resource access, monitoring and alerting, basic cost and utilization review, backup coordination and incident troubleshooting, escalating complex architecture or engineering matters to Azure specialists.
* Follow approved security, change and operational procedures and maintain accurate cloud configuration, support and troubleshooting documentation.



**Privileged Access Management: Delinea Privilege Manager \| Expert** 



* Administer Delinea Privilege Manager, application control and application whitelisting policies.
* Review and troubleshoot privilege elevation requests with Security; implement least\-privilege controls that support business operations.
* Resolve application compatibility issues caused by privilege restrictions and obtain required Security approvals for exceptions or changes.



**Qualifications and Experience** 



* Approximately 10 years of relevant infrastructure, endpoint and enterprise support experience, including advanced L2/L3 ownership of complex cases.
* Deep hands\-on expertise in Active Directory, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Windows endpoints and Intune; strong PagerDuty and Delinea administration capability, supported by good hands\-on exposure to Azure administration.
* Working knowledge of PowerShell, Azure Portal, Azure Resource Groups, virtual machines, storage accounts, networking fundamentals, RBAC, monitoring, endpoint networking, authentication, application troubleshooting, SMB/NTFS permissions and cloud collaboration platforms.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, customer service, prioritization, analytical troubleshooting, and technical documentation skills.
* Microsoft Azure, endpoint, identity, M365, security, or ITIL certifications are preferred.

Our office culture is designed to foster in\-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members, local and visiting, from other global offices.

 TELUS Digital is seeking an experienced SAP Technical lead to join our team. * Develop and maintain technical documentation, including system configurations, integration setup, and troubleshooting procedures.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest SAP technologies and advancements, identifying opportunities for system optimization and improvement.


**Skills**
* 7\+ years of experience as an SAP Technical Consultant or similar role.
* Strong skills in SAP technical administration, including system configuration, monitoring, and performance tuning.
* Deep technical knowledge in SAP Public Cloud and SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI).
* Experience troubleshooting integration issues between SAP and third\-party systems.

* Experience leading technical upgrades and system patching activities.

* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
* Experience with integrated third\-party systems such as Salesforce.com, Replicon, and SAP SuccessFactors is preferred.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at various levels of the organization.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and deliver high\-quality results.

 We are seeking a highly motivated, dynamic, and self\-driven candidate who would like to have a challenging and meaningful career path in information technology and the social sector. Information Technology (IT) is a key focus area in our organisation and requires a proactive and dynamic approach. The candidate should be dedicated and sincere towards her/his work and should always be open to learning new things. The candidate should have in\-depth subject matter knowledge, expertise, and experience. Timely and high\-quality delivery of goals would be essential and will be a key performance measurement criterion. S/he will be based out of Delhi NCR (Noida), India.
 




  





**About You** 



* You love all aspects of IT and are comfortable talking about WAPs, routers, and websites one minute, Microsoft Azure, SAP, and Salesforce the next, researching new technologies in the morning, and writing SOPs and meeting with developers in the afternoon.
* You enjoy working with cross\-functional teams to learn what their needs are and turn those needs into requirements and user stories/use cases.
* You enjoy working with programmers to build out the project/feature release plan.
* You are a team player and enjoy working with other IT professionals.
* You work well in an open planned environment and see everyone as an equal, no matter what their responsibilities are.
* You are flexible and adaptable and thrive in environments where each day is unlike the next.
* You operate with integrity and take pride in going above and beyond even when no one is watching.
* You love to start, run, and complete projects, no matter how big or small.
* You are excited to demonstrate your projects.
* You enjoy problem solving that requires research and development.
* You like to manage technology projects of any nature.

* As a social organisation, social change motivates us first. Our focus is on advancing our mission objectives \- to increase functioning, productivity, and income earning potential for our low\-income people by correcting impaired vision with eyeglasses.

* We serve low\-income people who are more than beneficiaries to us. The people (and the partners) we serve expect high\-quality eye\-screening and eyeglasses.
* To efficiently scale, we must deliver each new unit at less cost.
* We run our operations on financial metrics and social impact measures. We leverage a range of processes and practices to get the work done.

 You will be leading the IT department and the talented individuals that are part of the same. * Providing program insights efficiently.
* Working with teams across multiple locations.
* Overseeing the programming team.
* Experiencing managing software development projects.



  





**What’s Required** 



* 15\+ years’ experience in IT operations and software product development.
* Fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English
* Experience in feature release planning, product charter, scope definition, requirements gathering, project planning, change control, risk management, and reporting.
* Ability to break down the requirements into user stories and can run the stories with the organisation to define the prioritisation.
* At least 3 years’ project management experience using Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
* Experience working with SAP B1 and Salesforce.
* Experience managing a website.

* Meaningful experience working as a part of a team and demonstrated success collaborating with external consultants to move projects forward.

 by Infranews .  **Senior Consultant** 
 with expertise in
 **financial modelling and economic analysis**

**Responsibilities**
**Financial Modelling \& Analysis**

* Revenue, demand, and utilisation dynamics
* Capex (initial, expansion, lifecycle) and cost phasing
* Operating cost structures and performance benchmarks

**Economic \& Market Analysis**

* Demand drivers (economic growth, demographics, industry trends)
* Competitive positioning and benchmarking
* Regulatory and policy considerations (as applicable)
* Translating economic and demand insights into quantitative modelling assumptions.


**Transaction \& Strategic Advisory**
* Supporting the delivery of technical and commercial due diligence assignments from a financial and economic perspective.

* Revenue and demand assumptions
* Capex programmes and lifecycle requirements
* Operating strategies and cost forecasts
* Identifying key risks, gaps, and inconsistencies, and providing independent views on the robustness of underlying assumptions.
* Providing technical and commercial input into bids and pursuits, shaping competitive proposals through robust asset and demand insights to strengthen proposals.
* Supporting development and refinement of investment cases, financial projections, and strategic plans.
* Reviewing data room materials and financial models, ensuring consistency between technical, commercial, and financial inputs.
* Preparing clear, client\-ready outputs, articulating key risks, sensitivities, and value drivers to support decision\-making.
* Working closely with multidisciplinary teams to ensure alignment between technical assumptions and financial outputs.

title: Sr Technical Lead-Cloud & Infra Engg
description:
Area(s) of responsibility
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Ansible Automation \& Deployment
* Design, develop, and maintain Ansible playbooks, roles, and collections for provisioning, configuration management, OS patching, and compliance enforcement across enterprise Linux environments.
* Build and manage Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) pipelines integrating Ansible with CI/CD platforms (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD) to deliver repeatable, auditable deployments.
* Automate routine Linux operational tasks — user management, package installations, security hardening, disk expansion, log rotation — to reduce manual effort and eliminate configuration drift.
* Develop and maintain Ansible Automation Platform (AAP/AWX) workflows, including dynamic inventories, credentials management, and job scheduling.
* Integrate Ansible automation with AWS APIs and services (EC2, SSM, S3\) to support cloud\-native Linux provisioning and lifecycle management.
* Version\-control all automation artifacts in Git; conduct peer reviews and maintain documentation standards for all playbooks and roles.
* Linux System Administration \& Maintenance
* Administer enterprise Linux distributions (RHEL 7/8/9, CentOS, Oracle Linux, Amazon Linux 2/2023\) across on\-premises, hybrid, and AWS environments.
* Manage core Linux subsystems: kernel parameters, LVM/storage management, NFS/SMB mounts, network configuration (bonding, VLANs), firewalld/iptables, PAM, SSH hardening, and systemd services.
* Perform security hardening using CIS/STIG benchmarks; manage SELinux policies, sudoers configuration, and PKI/certificate lifecycle.
* Operate and optimize AWS Linux infrastructure: EC2 instance management, EBS volume management, AMI lifecycle, Auto Scaling Groups, and VPC networking for Linux workloads.
* Utilize AWS Systems Manager (SSM) for patch management, parameter store management, session management, and automated runbook execution on Linux fleets.
* Plan and execute scheduled maintenance: OS patching cycles, kernel upgrades, capacity planning, and infrastructure lifecycle activities in compliance with change management processes.


 Implement and validate high\-availability and disaster recovery configurations including clustering (Pacemaker/Corosync), load balancing, and snapshot\-based backup strategies

title: Beauty Advisor - SIS Counter
description:
**Company Description** 




 Kimirica is a luxury lifestyle brand focused on thoughtful self\-care, offering unique fragrances, premium vegan formulations, and creatively designed products that bring joy to everyday routines. The brand is 100% vegan, cruelty\-free, and paraben\-free, with a strong commitment to wellness, ethics, and sustainability. Trusted by leading luxury hotels and resorts worldwide, Kimirica has grown into a prominent Indian brand with a decade\-long legacy. The company designs, formulates, and manufactures a wide range of fragrances, bath and body, skincare, home, and wellness products, providing a holistic, experience\-driven approach to self\-care.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The Beauty Advisor – SIS Counter is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Noida. This role involves greeting and engaging customers at the store counter, understanding their beauty and self\-care needs, and recommending suitable Kimirica products with accurate product information. The Beauty Advisor will demonstrate product usage, provide basic skincare and self\-care guidance, and support customers in making informed purchase decisions. Daily responsibilities include maintaining visual merchandising and stock levels at the counter, achieving individual and store sales targets, processing transactions, and ensuring a clean, welcoming, and brand\-appropriate customer experience. The role also includes handling customer feedback, participating in promotional activities, and staying updated on new product launches and brand standards.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong customer\-facing abilities with skills in Customer Service and Retail Sales.
* Solid Product Knowledge and understanding of Skin Care to guide customers in selecting appropriate self\-care solutions.
* Background or training in Cosmetology to provide informed beauty and skincare recommendations.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and trust with diverse customers.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced retail environment, meet sales targets, and maintain high service standards.
* Prior experience as a beauty advisor, skincare consultant, or in premium retail is an advantage.
* Basic computer literacy for billing and inventory systems; familiarity with POS tools is helpful.
* High school diploma or equivalent; professional courses in beauty, skincare, or cosmetology are preferred.

title: Production Support Engineer
description:
We are hiring in Noida, India Only.
   

  

**About Ampliwork, Inc**
 Ampliwork builds Enterprise\-Grade AI Agents that amplify Human Potential™ to drive
   

  

 business productivity and growth since 2017\. Ampliwork’s AI Agents streamline complex
   

  

 multi\-step workflows in highly regulated industries such as Financial Services.
   

  

 Ampliwork builds and runs AI platforms for enterprise clients. Those platforms are in production, and the people using them need a reliable place to take questions, issues and requests. This is a new role, and it owns that first line of response.
   

  

 You take everything that arrives from client users, resolve what can be resolved, investigate what needs investigating, and pass to engineering only the items that genuinely require an engineer, complete and reproduced. Most of what comes in should be closed by you.
   

  

 The role covers several client deployments. Volumes vary by account and by week, so holding multiple contexts at once and prioritising sensibly across them is a central part of the job. Response and resolution targets are agreed with each client and vary by severity. We will walk through how that works at interview.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
****First response and first\-line resolution****
* Own the support queue end to end: acknowledge new requests promptly, classify them by severity, and drive every item to resolution or to a complete handoff.
* Answer usage and configuration questions directly, from the documentation and your own understanding of the product. A large share of inbound volume is not a defect: there are questions, workflow misunderstandings, enhancement ideas, and reports that turn out to be working as designed. Resolving those yourself is one of the main contributions of the role.
* Where the system behaviour is expected, walk the user through the correct workflow and close the loop with them. Where it is a defect, confirm that properly before escalating.
* Go back to the requester for whatever is missing, including screenshots, record references, steps to reproduce, timestamps and environment detail.


 Technical investigation and triage
   

  

* Carry out first\-level technical triage: inspect application and cloud logs, run read\-only database queries, reproduce the reported behaviour, and form your own view of the likely cause.
* Read application code well enough to locate the relevant logic and confirm or rule out a hypothesis.
* Work each ticket from more than one angle before drawing a conclusion, and recognise when you have reached the limit of what you can resolve on your own.
* Treat our internal AI triage tooling as a starting point rather than an answer. Check its classification and its suggested cause, correct it where it is wrong, and add your own findings.


**Escalation And Follow\-through**
* Escalate only the tickets that need it, with a reproducible case, logs, affected records, environment detail and your own analysis attached.
* Create and own the tasks sent downstream to the engineering team, then follow them through fix, review and release, and verify in production.
* Push back where a request sits outside agreed scope, and route it as an enhancement rather than letting it enter the queue as a defect.
* Judge when to ask for help. Flagging early is preferred to spending a day stuck on the same problem.


**Client Communication**
* Act as the named point of contact for client users, over email, the support portal and chat. You will be writing to experienced enterprise users, in some cases daily.
* Keep them informed at an agreed cadence, including regular status updates on high\-severity issues until they are resolved, whether or not there is progress to report.
* Tell clients plainly what is known, what is being done, and when they will next hear from you. Tickets should not go quiet.
* Hold your position courteously when a request is out of scope or a severity label is wrong, and know when to bring colleagues into the conversation.


**Knowledge, Reporting And Improvement**
* Contribute to the knowledge base as you go, covering known issues, workarounds, runbooks and standard responses, so that a repeat occurrence takes less work than the first. The work you do here will contribute directly to the skills of the triage AI Agent.
* Produce a weekly support report for each account, covering volume, mix, response performance, ageing, open high\-severity items and the recurring issues that warrant a permanent fix.
* Surface effort being spent outside agreed scope so that it can be reviewed.
* Give feedback on the triage tooling. Where its classification or draft replies are wrong, explain why, so that it can be improved rather than worked around.


**Essential**
****What we are looking for****
* Three to five years in application support, production support, technical support engineering, or a comparable client\-facing technical role.
* Python. Able to read and debug application code, and write small scripts to inspect data or verify behaviour.
* Cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent). Comfortable navigating logs and monitoring to trace an issue through a running system.
* SQL and PostgreSQL. Able to write your own queries to answer data\-level questions without waiting for someone else.
* A track record of resolving tickets rather than routing them. At interview we will ask you to talk through issues you closed yourself that others might have escalated.
* Excellent written English. Most of your output is writing, and much of it goes directly to a client. You will also regularly be on calls with client users, being able to explain how the system works using vocabulary that is relevant to client, is important.
* Self\-starting and methodical. You take notes, follow up on open items without being prompted, and keep track of everything that is outstanding.
* Comfortable being assertive. The role involves challenging a severity label, declining an out\-of\-scope request, and telling a client that what they are describing is not a defect.
* Able to carry several accounts and unrelated products at the same time, and to switch between them without losing track.
* Able to learn a complex domain application quickly. Our platforms carry substantial business logic, and supporting them well means understanding that logic rather than recognising screens.
* Comfortable being accountable for response times and for the client relationship, not only for ticket counts.


****Desirable****
* Experience working to defined service levels in enterprise, regulated or audited environments.
* Experience with an enterprise ticketing platform and a downstream engineering task tracker.
* Additional languages.
* Exposure to financial services, professional services, insurance, tax or transport operations.
* Experience working alongside AI agents or automation within a support workflow.


**How Success Is Measured**
****Horizon****
**What Good Looks Like**
 First 30 days
   

  

 You own the queue on your first account, acknowledge new requests within the agreed window, and classify severity correctly without help. Requests waiting on missing information are chased and moving.
   

  

 60 days
   

  

 Only the tickets that need an engineer reach engineering, and they arrive complete and reproduced. The weekly support report is running as a standing item, and the knowledge base covers the issues that recur.
   

  

 90 days
   

  

 The same model is running on a second account. You are proposing the product changes that would remove whole categories of ticket, and you own the support process itself, including intake, routing, escalation and client reporting.
   

  

 The headline measure is the proportion of inbound tickets resolved without engineering involvement.
   

  

****Tooling****
 Enterprise ticketing and task tracking, Microsoft 365, AWS (logs, monitoring and managed databases), PostgreSQL, Python, Git, and our internal AI triage tooling.

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a skilled SCCM/Intune Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This mid\-level role involves independently managing end\-to\-end endpoint lifecycle operations — OS deployment, patch management, application delivery, and device compliance — for large global enterprise clients.  OS Deployment \& Image Management

* Contribute to Windows Autopilot profile configuration and deployment for Intune\-managed devices.

 Patch Management

* Design and implement application supersedence and uninstall workflows.

* Develop PowerShell scripts for endpoint automation, reporting, and operational efficiency improvements.

title: EOE Process Governance Manager
description:
**Join our Team**
**About This Opportunity**
 The EOE Process Governance Manager is responsible for driving EOE process\-based autonomy to enable ANO ways of working through process standardization, standard process metrics, improvements, audits, analysing deviations, and reporting KPIs. They are also responsible for identifying automation and AAA opportunities, implementing process improvements and best practices. EOE Process Governance Manager within SL Operate Service Management, reporting to the respective Line Manager within SL Operate Service Management is responsible to deliver value to the customer/stakeholder by increasing the process\-based autonomy aligned to ANO wow, analysing monitoring Process KPI, engaging stakeholders \& proposing automated process solutions, driving process improvements to bring value to overall operations \& organization.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Identify automation opportunities to drive process\-based autonomy aligned with ANO ways of working and ensure AAA teams get detailed feedback on the same.
* Work with the BPMS team to identify opportunities to define service flows for process\-based autonomy and implementation of AAA use cases for successful implementation.
* Report on the current state of process\-based autonomy and give feedback on existing automation effectiveness while suggesting ideas and actions to improve the same.
* Develop standardized, reusable templates for common processes to accelerate automation and reduce manual intervention.
* Define and drive standardization of the processes (including Change Management) including work instructions, process metrics and global best practices across the board for all operational processes.
* Ensure standardisation through tracking the use of AAA capabilities to automate delivery tasks. Coordinating with the SDUs and MA MS teams for process governance as key component of overall MS governance.
* Ensure contract\-level process governance with key management stakeholders at agreed intervals and track improvement actions.MA support activities (KS activities with Operational staff of different MS contracts, Process related Governance and meetings with MSCLT and CU’s etc.).
* Perform regular assessment of actual ways of working of operational teams and maintain notes of scenarios with timelines and stakeholder’s details \& Perform and publish gap analysis on actual ways of working with respect to standard process framework, global best practices \& policies and defined delivery solution.
* Conduct quarterly/yearly process audits to ensure any major process deviation from EOE framework are reported and corrected through relevant forums.


**You will bring**
* 6 years of experience in managed services, with strong expertise in the MS delivery model, EOE framework, associated processes, best practices, audit frameworks, and operational metrics.
* Well\-versed in key managed services delivery challenges, AAA capabilities, process automation and optimization, along with a conceptual understanding of ANO.
* Experience in managing senior stakeholders, leading process improvement initiatives, and tracking and reporting progress on those improvements.
* BSc/BTech/BE or equivalent degree.
* Managed Services hands\-on experience within NOC/ MSCLT. Trained or certified on the process framework of ITIL and/or Etom.
* Excellent knowledge of TMForum ANO framework and various ANO methodologies.
* Ability to explain relevant Process frameworks.
* Working knowledge of MSDP tool suite and Automation, AI/ML \& Analytics, BPMS etc.
* Six Sigma / Lean training and implementation experience.


**Note\-** 
 All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Role Description:**
 As part of our EY GRC Tech team you’ll contribute technically to IT Risk and SAP S4 transformation client engagements An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. You’ll also identify potential business opportunities for Ernst \& Young within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate. Similarly, you’ll anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.
   

  

 The opportunity
   

  

 We’re looking for Manager to join the group of our EY GDS GRC Tech Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Interacts with business stakeholders to gather, understand, document, and analyse business requirements.
* Analyse reports and assessments to provide insights on whether a solution/technology being implemented is meeting business requirements.
* Evaluates business models, processes, and operations to develop a good understanding of business needs and requirements.
* Perform control testing for both ITAC \& ITGC as per the client scope and requirement.
* Work effectively as a team member, share responsibility, provide support, maintain communication and update senior team members on progress of tasks.
* Conduct research and assist senior team members in preparing client presentations and information memorandums.
* Continuously strive towards exceeding client \& team expectations and work on increasingly complex assignments
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client/onsite personnel.
* Ensuring adherence to quality protocols specified for the project


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Candidate will have minimum 8 – 12 years of experience in SAP IT Audit with knowledge of IT governance practices.
* Lead SAP Risk and Controls projects, ensuring high\-quality delivery and client satisfaction.
* Should have completed at least 5\-6 Risk \& Control engagements covering pre\-\& post implementation reviews, assessments, control design and testing for SAP ECC and/or S4 HANA landscape.
* Perform SAP audits, focusing on system integrity and data accuracy.
* Design and assess SAP S4 controls, identifying gaps and recommending improvements.
* Familiarity with key business process such as Order To Cash, Procure To Pay, and Record To Report and utilize functional knowledge of key business processes to enhance control frameworks.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate risk and control considerations into broader project objectives.
* Provide thought leadership and insights on SAP risk and control trends and best practices.


**Qualifications:**
* Good understanding of the COSO framework, Sarbanes\-Oxley Act (Sections 302 and 404\), GDPR etc
* Strong experience in performing test of design and effectiveness for internal controls related to SOD, ITAC, ITDM, ICFR and IFRS along with the ability to suggest best practice recommendations.
* Proven experience in SAP Risk and Controls projects.
* Strong understanding of SAP ECC \& S4 HANA environments.
* Excellent project management and leadership skills.
* Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing.
* Relevant professional certifications (e.g., CISA, CRISC, CIA) are desirable.
* Good to have exposure in SAP Basis testing \& SAP ITGC testing will be preferable
* Candidate with professional consulting experience in technology risk management ideally with a Big 4 or similar large consulting firm will be preferred.
* Experience in leading implementation / Risk and Controls engagements for various clients
* Experience in drafting proposals, RFP , pursuits, innovations etc.
* Strong communication, presentation and team building skills and experience in producing high quality reports, papers, and presentations.
* Owns the relationship with senior business stakeholders to fully understand complex business / functional requirements and strategies and oversees the translation of these into complex technical requirements and specifications, guiding senior management towards accepting change brought about through process and organizational change.
* Establishes the contribution that technology can make to business objectives, defining strategies, validating and justifying business needs, conducting feasibility studies, producing high\-level and detailed business models and overseeing the development and implementation of solutions, taking into account the implications of change on the organisation and all stakeholders.
* Should possess the ability to conduct and drive workshops with the client stakeholders on understanding client’s process \& system landscape
* Work effectively as a team member and drive the delivery of IT audit documents independently
* Demonstrate sound technical understanding of IT Audits (ITGC \& ITACs) for SAP environment.
* Knowledge of the COSO framework, Sarbanes\-Oxley Act (Sections 302 and 404\) etc
* Inculcate positive learning attitude and the zeal to upskill as well as cross\-skill.
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures.
* Participating in the organization\-wide people initiatives
* Maintain an educational program to continuously upskill.
* Foster teamwork, quality culture and lead by example while training and mentoring juniors
* Inculcate positive learning culture and support learning agenda for self and team

* SAP Functional Knowledge

* SAP ECC \& S4 HANA

title: Principal Engineer Water & Wastewater_Plant 3D
description:
**Job Description**
 The suitable candidate for this role is a Principal BIM Engineer specializing in Plant and Piping design for Water and Wastewater projects, with a strong focus on Digital Delivery. The role involves close coordination with design engineers and digital teams across India and New Zealand, supporting project delivery through high‑quality CAD and 3D modelling outputs.
   

  

 The Principal BIM Engineer will take ownership of 3D modelling, drafting, and preparation of design documentation for water supply and wastewater (sewerage and drainage) infrastructure, including treatment plants, pump stations, and associated piping networks. The role supports projects across all stages, from concept and preliminary design through to detailed design and construction documentation.
   

  

 Key responsibilities include developing and maintaining Plant 3D/Piping models, Revit 3D modelling \& Civil 3D producing layouts, profiles, long\-sections, and detailed drawings, and ensuring compliance with provided standards, digital requirements and project specifications. The focus is on delivering accurate, coordinated, and construction‑ready CAD deliverables that meet client and project expectations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Deliver Plant \& Piping CAD and BIM outputs for water and wastewater infrastructure projects, including pipelines, pumping stations, treatment plants, recycled water schemes, dams, and desalination facilities, in line with WSP and client standards.
* Prepare 2D and 3D deliverables using AutoCAD and Plant 3D, including GA drawings, piping layouts, isometrics, plot plans, sections, PFDs, P\&IDs, and construction‑ready drawings.
* Develop, manage, and maintain federated BIM models, undertaking clash detection, coordination, issue resolution, reporting, and data management within the Common Data Environment (Autodesk Vault).
* Produce Bills of Materials (BOMs), quantity take‑offs, schedules, and equipment lists in accordance with project and client requirements.
* Coordinate with multi‑disciplinary teams (civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, and process) to deliver integrated and constructible design outcomes.
* Liaise with New Zealand / ANZ lead offices to support cross‑regional project delivery and effective communication.
* Review and check drawings and models to ensure compliance with WSP drafting standards, client requirements, applicable codes, and statutory regulations.
* Take ownership of CAD delivery for small to large projects, contributing to design reviews, coordination meetings, and technical discussions.
* Mentor and guide junior and intermediate CAD staff, promoting best practices, efficiency, and capability development.
* Apply and champion QA/QC processes, supporting audits, continuous improvement, and compliance with WSP management systems.
* Provide regular progress updates, risk identification, and workload forecasts to line management.


**Required Technical And Soft Skills**
* Strong experience in Plant \& Piping design for Water and Wastewater infrastructure, delivering GA drawings, layouts, isometrics, PFDs, P\&IDs, and detailed construction drawings.
* Advanced proficiency in Autodesk AutoCAD and Plant 3D, with hands‑on experience in BIM coordination, clash detection, and federated model management.
* Ability to interpret engineering inputs, specifications, vendor data, and survey information, and prepare BOMs, quantity take‑offs, and schedules.
* Good understanding of CAD/Digital Delivery standards and international (NZ, Australian, UK, US) design standards.
* Experience working in multi‑disciplinary and cross‑regional project environments.
* Strong communication, coordination, and collaboration skills, with a professional approach to design reviews and stakeholder engagement.
* Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring ability.
* High attention to detail, quality focus, and ability to manage multiple priorities within deadlines.
* Proactive, self‑driven, and solution‑oriented mindset, with willingness to adopt new technologies and develop cross‑disciplinary knowledge.
* Commitment to Health \& Safety, sustainability, and WSP Future Ready® principles.


 Software Proficiencies
   

  

* Demonstrated advanced hands\-on expertise in AutoCAD Plant 3D \& BIM coordination is a critical requirement for this role.
* Extensive hands\-on experience in AutoCAD (2D), Navisworks, Revit, and Civil 3D is essential.
* Proven experience in using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) and BIM 360 platforms for project delivery and collaboration. Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum qualification of a bachelor’s degree in civil or mechanical engineering, or (B.Tech or equivalent) in a relevant engineering discipline


**Experience**
* 12–18 years of proven experience in water supply and wastewater utility projects.
* Experience in utilities water, wastewater, recycled water pipeline projects, including potable water supply mains (DN50–DN1200\), pumping stations, reservoirs, water sampling stations, bulk metering systems, emergency storage systems, odour control units and chemical dosing systems.
* Proven experience in AU/NZ projects is highly preferred, with additional exposure to UK, US, or Middle East projects considered an advantage.

title: Senior Analyst (Correspondent Banking) - Noida, India
description:
**Job Description:**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and analytically strong Correspondent Banking Transaction Monitoring Analyst to join the First Line of Defence AML Transaction Monitoring team. The role is focused on identifying, reviewing, and investigating potentially suspicious activity across correspondent banking transactions to help protect the bank, its customers, and society from financial crime risks.
   

  

 The Analyst will be responsible for reviewing transaction monitoring alerts, assessing risk indicators, identifying unusual or non\-expected activity, and preparing well\-supported investigation narratives. This role requires strong analytical judgement, attention to detail, understanding of payment flows, and the ability to work collaboratively with internal stakeholders across financial crime, compliance, client risk, legal, sales, product, and engineering teams.
   

  

 Depending on the candidate’s skills, knowledge, and experience, the role may be aligned to different seniority levels within the team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Review and investigate transaction monitoring alerts generated across correspondent banking activity, including customer and peer\-bank transaction flows.
* Analyse transactions for potential money laundering, terrorist financing, tax evasion, sanctions, PEP, adverse media, and other financial crime risks.
* Assess risk associated with correspondent banking relationships and transaction activity, applying a risk\-based approach to investigation outcomes.
* Identify and investigate red flags such as high\-risk jurisdiction exposure, nested banking, structuring, round\-dollar or round\-tripping payments, trade\-based money laundering indicators, and PEP\-linked transactions.
* Analyse complex financial transactions using knowledge of payment message formats including SWIFT MT and ISO 20022\.
* Conduct detailed reviews of transaction activity to identify non\-expected patterns, anomalies, and activity outside the bank’s risk appetite.
* Prepare clear, concise, and well\-supported case narratives documenting investigation findings, rationale for closure or escalation, and recommendations for suspicious activity reporting where required.
* Escalate suspicious or high\-risk activity to relevant internal teams, departments, or authorities in line with applicable procedures.
* Maintain accurate records and a complete audit trail for all reviews, decisions, and investigation outcomes.
* Collaborate with Client Risk, Compliance, Legal, Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to support ongoing client activity reviews and improve data quality, monitoring processes, and operating effectiveness.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of monitoring processes, procedures, policies, and the overall operating model by identifying gaps and recommending enhancements.
* Stay informed on FATF guidance, sanctions regime updates, and emerging financial crime typologies relevant to correspondent banking.


**Required Qualifications And Skills**
* Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience in AML, transaction monitoring, financial crime compliance, or a similar role, preferably with exposure to client activity monitoring.
* Strong understanding of correspondent banking, banking products, transaction flows, and transaction analysis.
* Demonstrated knowledge of payment message formats, including SWIFT MT and ISO 20022 messages.
* Ability to analyse complex datasets, identify patterns, detect anomalies, and communicate insights effectively to varied audiences.
* Familiarity with transaction monitoring systems and proficiency in data analysis tools or software.
* Strong documentation, case narrative writing, and investigation skills.
* Sound judgement and ability to make risk\-based decisions in a fast\-paced, dynamic, and multi\-directional work environment.
* Ability to build or support frameworks, procedures, and process improvement initiatives.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, presentation, organizational, planning, and time management skills.
* Team\-oriented mindset with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Professional certifications such as CAMS, CFE, or other relevant financial crime compliance certifications are preferred.
* Prior experience in correspondent banking transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, PEP/adverse media review, or suspicious activity investigation would be advantageous.

We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

 We are seeking an experienced Senior Threat Hunter to join our Managed Detection and Response team. This role is responsible for proactively identifying advanced threats that evade traditional security controls through intelligence\-driven, hypothesis\-based threat hunting.
 



 The ideal candidate will leverage telemetry from endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and security platforms to uncover malicious activity, improve detection coverage, and strengthen overall security operations.

**Description**
 Job Description, Consultant – LTOH
   

  

 Position: Consultant – Livestock Technology \& One Health (LTOH) \& Goat Enterprises
   

  

 Duration: Until June 2027
   

  

 Organization: Passing Gifts Pvt. Ltd.
   

  

 Location: Kolkata, West Bengal (may need to travel to Bihar and Odisha as per requirement)
   

  

**Overview**
 The Consultant will serve as a technical and enterprise resource to strengthen community agro\-vet entrepreneurs (CAVEs)/Pashu Sakhis/Community Animal Health Workers (CAHWs) to equip them for preventive veterinary healthcare for small and large ruminants and goat enterprises in West Bengal and may require travelling to Bihar \& Odisha under the projects funded by Zoetis Foundation and IRRI, India.
   

  

 The position will contribute to Zoetis foundation and IRRI’s objectives of strengthening Community Agro\-vet Entrepreneurs (CAVEs)/Pashu Sakhis/Community Animal Health Workers (CAHWs) and goat enterprises, improving husbandry practices, and market participation of women\-led goat enterprises.
   

  

 The role combines capacity building training to CAVEs/PS/CAHWs with enterprise development support to:
   

  

* Create a trained cadre of CAVEs/PS/CAHWs in West Bengal (120 to 150 Pashu Sakhis)
* Improve livestock productivity and management systems
* Promote market‑oriented goat enterprises
* Strengthening market linkages of the goat farmers
* Enhance access to services, inputs, finance, and business opportunities
* Support women’s participation and leadership in goat enterprises


**Scope Of Work**
* CAVEs/PS/CAHWs training \& Strengthening
* Search and selection of NGOs/ Govt. Departments/other agencies in West Bengal who work on livestock and CAVE/PS/CAHW development.
* Establish linkages and collaboration with the organizations/agencies for organizing training programs
* Mapping of potential CAVEs/PS/CAHWs for forming training batches in collaboration with the selected organizations/agencies.
* Selection of suitable training venue for conducting training.
* Selection of vendor for first aid kits medicines and/or selection of vendor for procuring bags for first aid kits.
* Provide training for CAVEs/PS/CAHWs on small and large ruminants management and primary healthcare.
* Writing training reports along with registration of participants and relevant photographs
* Ensure recordkeeping and data collection from trained CAVEs of their services
* Formation of WhatsApp group for the CAVEs/PS/CAHWs for follow up and support
* Goat Enterprise Development \& Value Chain Strengthening (in North 24 Pargana district only)
* Implement goat enterprise and value chain strategies
* Promote improved production practices (selective breeding, strategic feeding, fodder bank, climate reliant housing, better healthcare \& disease prevention).
* Support aggregation and marketing systems at group and cluster levels
* Facilitate market linkages with traders, buyers, and processors Deliverables: Higher productivity, improved commercial performance, stronger aggregation, better market access.
* Support field\-level implementation of goat enterprise initiatives, aggregation systems, and market\-linked production systems.
* Monitoring, Learning \& Reporting
* Maintain strong training and enterprise development data
* Field visit for ensuring appropriate implementations
* Periodic virtual call and other digital communications with the CAVEs/PS/CAHWs/farmers.
* Document best practices, innovations, and success stories
* Prepare timely reports and updates Deliverables: Reliable data, documented models, improved monitoring and learning system


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Education: Bachelor’s/master’s in veterinary science \& animal Husbandry, Livestock Production \& Management, or related fields
* Experience: 2–3 years in livestock and CAVEs/PS/CAHWs development, understanding on goat value chains, or rural livestock\-based livelihoods
* Preferred: Experience in livestock extension, goat enterprise development, market linkages, and government linkages/development projects.


 Essential Competencies
   

  

* Strong knowledge of livestock (small \& large ruminant) production systems, animal health, nutrition, and breeding
* Understanding of enterprise development, aggregation, and market led value chains
* Skills in facilitation, training, mentoring, and capacity building
* Analytical, organizational, and problem‑solving abilities
* Proficiency in MS Office and digital data tools
* Fluency in Bengali is must, English, and Hindi.
* Willingness to travel extensively mostly within West Bengal.
* Motivated to work responsibly with little supervision.
* Ability to meet and deal with others in a courteous and tactful manner.
* Ability to work with sensitive information and to always maintain confidentiality.
* Knowledge of word processing, spreadsheets, PowerPoint, and electronic mail software (Microsoft preferred).

The role may also include mentoring junior therapists and supporting continuous quality improvement initiatives within the center.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Clinical expertise in physiotherapy with a strong focus on neuro rehabilitation, spinal cord injury management, and activity\-based recovery programs.

description:
**Dominators Business Tribe · Greater Noida West · On\-site · Full\-time** 




  




 About the role
 
 Dominators Business Tribe helps Indian working professionals build and scale digital product businesses. As part of our flagship DBT Accelerator programme, we build and run Meta ad campaigns for our students — real businesses, with real budgets.
 



 We're hiring the person who will run those campaigns.
 



 This is an operations role, not a creative strategy role. You'll work from a documented system with AI\-assisted reporting that handles the heavy analysis. Your job is to execute it accurately across many accounts, make the calls it surfaces, and keep our students informed.
 



**Freshers are welcome.** 
 If you've run even one Meta campaign and you're precise, organised and curious, we will train you on everything else.
 



  




 What you'll do
 
**Daily** 
 — Review the automated performance report across all active accounts. Act on what it flags: pause what isn't working, scale what is, escalate what's broken. Around 30–45 minutes of focused decision\-making.
 



**Weekly** 
 — Send each student a clear performance update. Join the Wednesday coaching call to stay aligned with what our students are learning.
 



**For every new student** 
 — Set up access to their ad account, verify the pixel is firing correctly, build the campaign to our naming convention, and launch it. Around two hours per account.
 



**Always** 
 — Flag problems early. An account heading for trouble at ₹3,000 spent is a conversation; at ₹30,000 it's a refund.
 



 You'll begin with 10–25 accounts and grow as we do, and you'll join our 10:15 AM daily team huddle.
 



  




 What we're looking for
 
**Essential** 



* Basic hands\-on exposure to Meta Ads Manager — a personal campaign, an internship, a college project or a small business all count
* Clear written English; you'll send client updates every week
* Genuinely organised. Managing 25 accounts is a systems problem before it's a marketing problem
* Trustworthy with other people's accounts and budgets
* Comfortable following a documented process — and speaking up when the process is wrong



  





**Good to have** 



* Familiarity with Business Manager, Events Manager or pixel setup
* Exposure to landing pages, checkout tools or funnels
* Interest in digital products, coaching or info\-product businesses
* Comfort using AI tools in daily work



  





**Not required** 
 — a design background, agency experience, or large\-budget campaigns. Ours start at ₹300/day.
 



  




 What we offer
 * **₹20,000 – ₹30,000 per month** 
 , negotiable based on experience
* Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, on\-site at Greater Noida West
* Structured training on a documented system, with AI tooling that removes the grunt work
* Ownership of a core delivery function with direct access to the founder
* Real campaigns, real budgets, real revenue outcomes — you'll learn more in six months here than in two years of theory

 Time Type: Full Time
   

  

 Job Description: Database Infrastructure Engineer
   

  

 Industry
   

  

  

* Industrial Technology and Automation: Logistics \& Supply Chain


 Employment Type
   

  

  

* Full\-time


 Are you ready to develop your career in a rapidly growing and successful global company acting in a fast\-paced role? If you are someone looking for a position that challenges and inspire you in a successful international company, DSV is your place.
   

  

 The DSV group, headquartered in Denmark, is one of the biggest transports and logistics companies in the world, with more than 75,000 dedicated employees, operating in more than 90 countries.
   

  

 You will join a global and determined group driven forward by the desire to grow and will be part of a dynamic group, which is characterized by high level professionalization and constant improvement.
   

  

 Who do we look for?
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

 As a Database Infrastructure Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the architecture of our database systems. You will work closely with other IT professionals and departments to ensure our database infrastructure is robust, scalable, and aligned with business needs. Additionally, you will participate in guard duty rotations to ensure 24/7 support and monitoring of our database systems.
   

  

  

* Infrastructure Design: Develop and implement database infrastructure strategies that support business goals and ensure high availability, scalability, and performance.
* Architecture Development: Design and architect database solutions, including data modeling, schema design, and integration with other systems.
* Technology Evaluation: Evaluate and recommend new database technologies and tools to enhance our infrastructure.
* Automation: Implement automation for database deployment, management, and monitoring using tools like Ansible to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
* Virtualization: Utilize virtualization technologies such as VMware, OpenShift, and Kubernetes to manage and deploy containerized database applications.
* Vulnerability Management: Identify and address database vulnerabilities, ensuring timely application of patches and updates to maintain security and compliance.
* Security: Ensure database security by designing and implementing robust security measures, including access controls and encryption.
* Disaster Recovery: Develop and maintain disaster recovery plans to ensure data integrity and availability in case of failures.
* Collaboration: Work with development and operations teams to support database\-related projects and initiatives.
* Documentation: Create and maintain detailed documentation of database architecture, configurations, and procedures.
* Guard Duty: Participate in guard duty rotations to provide 24/7 support and monitoring of database systems.


 Qualifications:
   

  

  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in database infrastructure engineering and architecture.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in database management systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, DB2, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB), data modeling, infrastructure automation tools (e.g., Ansible), and virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, OpenShift, Kubernetes) Strong architecture skills are essential.
* Problem\-Solving: Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to design and implement complex database solutions.
* Communication: Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
* Certifications: Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect, Oracle Certified Master, AWS Certified Solutions Architect) are a plus.


 Location: Noida (India)
   

  

 We offer you:
   

  

 The opportunity to expand your experience in a truly international, world\-class company whose philosophy is that your everyday work should be both varied and full of professional challenges, with wide opportunities for constant professional and personal development.
   

  

 Additionally, we offer the following:
   

  

  

* Medical Insurance including family and Parents up to 10 Lakh INR per year
* 2\.5 days earned leave per month which is 30 days in a calendar year \& 10 days Sick Leave in a year
* Parking for 4\-wheeler or 2\-wheeler vehicle
* Personal Mobile and Internet expenses reimbursed per calendar month subject to maximum cap.


**DSV – Global Transport and Logistics**
 DSV is a dynamic workplace that fosters inclusivity and diversity. We conduct our business with integrity, respecting different cultures and the dignity and rights of individuals. When you join DSV, you are working for one of the very best performing companies in the transport and logistics industry. You’ll join a talented team of approximately 75,000 employees in over 80 countries, working passionately to deliver great customer experiences and high\-quality services. DSV aspires to lead the way towards a more sustainable future for our industry and are committed to trading on nature’s terms.
   

  

 We promote collaboration and transparency and strive to attract, motivate and retain talented people in a culture of respect. If you are driven, talented and wish to be part of a progressive and versatile organisation, we’ll support you and your need to achieve your potential and forward your career.
   

  

 Visit dsv.com and follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook and Twitter.
